answer: A Pearl-ivory raven beacon-decay bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits on one pearl slot in the ivory ledger. First 35, the k-th 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool; an honest agent files once and keeps its bond.
